payload.Shared Contract Handoff: CODE_REVIEW.ko.md sections1–8 and per-element table. Root owns semantic design; Sol concrete product APIs and internal algorithms within frozen meaning; independent Astra test inputs/oracles. AUTHORING owns typed input/plan/DTO, CAUSAL actual producer/subscriber/source/queue/receipt semantics, STRIKE native cast-target modifier, STATE owner/clone/budget/reclaim/Continue. All shared new APIs become available after atomic runtime node; PUBLIC/VERIFY consume actual implementations. Whole-file sequential ownership for embedded test modules/registration. No proposed symbol is presumed existing.
payload.Known Unknown/Limitations: Exact RON/Rust naming and private representations are bounded implementation choices; schema drift affecting public meaning returns to Root/P2G owner. Performance/resource cost must be measured where affected with unchanged guards. Predecessor evidence reused selectively, no automatic all-tests finalization. Product/test writers do not perform final independent audit.
